name: altaks-claude
description: Altaks' shared Claude Code configuration: personal dev skills, an opt-in cybersecurity skill library and two opt-in mods for subagent work.

plugins.name: cybersec
plugins.description: 872 offensive + defensive security skills (red/blue/DFIR/cloud/mobile/IoT/CTF), MITRE-mapped. Opt-in; enable only in projects doing authorized security work.

plugins.name: model-gatekeeper
plugins.description: Mod: routes each subagent to the cheapest fitting model tier (haiku, sonnet, opus) as it starts. Opt-in.

plugins.name: agent-board
plugins.description: Mod: a side pane of cards showing what each subagent is doing, plus an on-demand graph of who spawned or messaged whom. Opt-in.
